title: Complementary events partition Bernoulli restriction probability
statement:
Fix $n$ and a parameter $p$ with $0 \le p \le 1$, and let $A$ be a predicate on restrictions of $n$ variables. Writing $\Pr[A]$ for the probability that $A$ holds under a Bernoulli($p$) random restriction, one has
\[
  \Pr[A] + \Pr[\neg A] = 1,
\]
where $\neg A$ is the predicate that holds exactly for those restrictions on which $A$ fails.
hypotheses_covered: A is a predicate on restrictions of n variables
replaced:
For a Bernoulli restriction probability with parameter $0 \le p \le 1$ and a decidable
predicate $A$ on restrictions, $\Pr[A] + \Pr[\lnot A] = 1$.
